titel: Donna Lewis: Beyond “I Love You Always Forever”

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts

einzeiler: Donna Lewis on her biggest hit, breast cancer survival and new music.
kurzfassung: Singer-songwriter Donna Lewis reflects on the creation and lasting impact of her global hit "I Love You Always Forever". She discusses stepping away from the spotlight to raise her son and turning her battle with breast cancer into the healing musical project "Rooms of the View". Additionally, she shares insights about her latest album, "Wanderlust", and her ongoing creative journey.
stichpunkte: Manifesting and writing "I Love You Always Forever" while living in Birmingham, England
Navigating the whirlwind of sudden global success and industry expectations in the nineties
Stepping back from touring to focus on full-time motherhood and creative experimentation
Using music as therapy and recording the album "Rooms of the View" during breast cancer treatment
Collaborating with longtime friend David Lowe to produce the uplifting new album "Wanderlust"
Shifting artistic focus from absolute perfection to authentic emotion and personal connection
Future plans including a 30-year anniversary release of her debut album and working on a musical for the stage

beschreibung:
Show Notes
Behind an unforgettable song is a story that reaches far beyond the charts. On Almost Live Nashville, Donna Lewis reflects on years of developing her craft before worldwide success and the lessons that taught her to trust her creative instincts.
Donna shares how motherhood reshaped her priorities and how writing during breast cancer treatment became a source of comfort and expression. She also discusses collaborating with longtime friend David Lowe, embracing emotion over perfection, and her dreams of intimate theater performances and bringing a musical to the stage.
Find Donna at DonnaLewis.com and on Instagram and Facebook at Donna Lewis Music.
